objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, reactivated, translated, and evaluated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected type for a document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation assigned to a document type or document number.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to companies.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to areas of validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the document in its life cycle or workflow.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata printable in a template-based document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid until date.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration after which archived documents are physically deleted.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect e-mail notification on the next released version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect acknowledgement workflow tasks on the next released version.

objs.name: template
objs.description: Template selectable when creating a new document object for a document type.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover or used as document content.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary object added to a document and released or published directly via properties switches.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled object attached to a document, released with the main document and subject to versioning.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for an existing document and managed without initially affecting content or version history.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating in authoring, reviewing, releasing, reading, acknowledging, translating, or administering documents and requests.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role or authorization role of the user.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group assigned to users or documents for authorization, distribution, reading, or archiving.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, acknowledgement, validity extension, override, reactivation, or translation.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to process extension of validity.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request created for a document to declare it out of force and archive it.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request created to re-validate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of assigned user groups and persons used for document distribution, authorization, dashboard assignment, e-mail notification, and acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by a recipient that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report or search available for documents, instructions, workflow status, or acknowledgements.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific display listing documents and document-dependent details relevant to the user.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document checked and released with workflow support.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process that can be linked with documents through database integration.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit that can be linked with documents through database integration.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk that can be linked with documents through database integration.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data that can be linked with documents through database integration.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: select_template
evts.description: Select a template when creating a new document object.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate a new document based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after editing.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current converted document version on the web or in dashboards.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Change released document content or properties, creating a new editing version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_participant
evts.description: Assign author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, or translation participants in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new main document version.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark or archive an attachment with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release workflow for a document.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves release of the document.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A participant rejects during review or release, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release so addressed readers can see it.

evts.name: notify_user
evts.description: Inform involved users by e-mail about workflow status, tasks, document release, change proposals, validity extension, override, or acknowledgement.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a valid released document is revised.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned change proposals in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension thirty days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the validity extension request with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, update valid until date, and delete the request.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new version and update the document when it needs revision.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate validity extension process when a revised version is released or override is declared.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request for AKS or override for a selected document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: Process the override request with workflow support.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare documents and attachments invalid and archive them by revoking authorizations except archive group.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after out-of-force declaration.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the document for reactivation.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: Process and confirm reactivation through workflow.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version, retain metadata, restore authorizations and distribution assignments, and reactivate archived attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain user groups and persons in a document distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request recipients to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement through workflow without signature.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Evaluate documents, instructions, workflow status, or acknowledgements using reports or dashboards.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check a translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release a translated language version so it is visible to authorized readers in the login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition and reference the original document.

o2o.description: One or more templates can be defined for each document type and selected for new documents.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Attachments are associated with a main document and released with it.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in it.
Users can be assigned to documents as readers, authors, co-authors, reviewers, releasers, translators, or creators.
Authorization groups or reader groups can be assigned specifically to documents.
Users are assigned to user groups by technical administration.
Workflow tasks are created for document release, acknowledgement, validity extension, override, reactivation, or translation.
Signatures of participants are documented in the system for each released document version.
A validity extension request is linked to the document to be checked.
An override request is created for a selected document.
A reactivation request selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
A distribution list is maintained for a document.
Persons can be directly assigned to a distribution list.
User groups can be assigned to a distribution list.
Acknowledgements are confirmations for a current released document version.
Users in distribution confirm acknowledgements.
Dashboards list documents relevant to a user and display document-dependent details.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.
The acknowledgement report lists acknowledgements depending on status.
Translated language versions belong to released documents.
A document can be specified as visible or not visible in clients.
Documents can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents can be automatically linked with master data.
Documents can reference or be linked to other documents, including local documents referencing an original document.

o2e.description: Document is created from a selected template.
Document object cover receives uploaded file.
Workflow participants are maintained on the document.
Additional information is added to the document.
Author decides which object type is added.
Additional information is released and published.
Attachment is added to the document.
Author decides which object type is added.
Modification triggers a new main document version.
Attachment archiving is tied to the main document version release.
Release workflow is started for the document.
Author or co-author starts the workflow.
Creation of the document is signed.
Notification concerns workflow task status or existence.
Notification can concern a change proposal.
New editing version is created for the document.
Change proposal is created for document.
Employee with author rights creates proposal.
Change proposal is scheduled for implementation.
Scheduling creates a new document version.
Completed change proposal is no longer displayed in document.
Request is linked to the document.
Releaser or release-process participants perform checks.
Document remains valid and valid until date is updated.
Request is deleted after additional validity is declared.
Attachments are also released and receive same validity.
New version is created and document is updated.
Validity extension process is terminated and request deleted.
Termination follows release of revised version or override declaration.
Request is created for selected document.
User with write access creates request.
Initiator, reviewer, releaser, or releaser currently on document performs process steps.
Document is declared invalid and archived.
Attachments are declared invalid and archived.
Archive group retains read access while other rights are revoked.
Existing edited versions of document are deleted.
Archived document is physically deleted after archive period.
Only Business Admin group may create requests.
Document is reactivated with a new version.
Attachments archived with the document are reactivated.
Distribution list users and groups are confirmed from invalidated version.
Distribution list is maintained for document.
User groups are assigned to distribution.
E-mail notification is sent when new document version is released.
Assigned users and groups determine recipients.
Users of assigned groups receive e-mail notification.
Acknowledgement is requested for released document.
Users are requested by e-mail to confirm.
Users of assigned groups are requested.
Workflow-supported acknowledgement task is completed without signature.
Document becomes visible in corresponding login language after translation release.
Document visibility is specified by client.
Client is where document is visible or not visible.
New local document is created and references original document.
Local document is created in client.
